title: Bithumb says victims of October internal-system data leak exceed 7,159 and leak period was Oct 12 to 27
date_note: Date of Bithumb's updated announcement as reported on 25 November; the leak itself occurred in October.
summary: Bithumb said in a 25 November notice that more people were affected than the 7,159 announced earlier (6,444 customers and 715 employees and partner staff), without giving a new number. The leak period was extended from about one hour on 27 October to 12 to 27 October. IT Daily reports the exported files included transaction history, wallet addresses and ID copies. Bithumb says its exchange service and customer database were not directly breached.
plain: Bithumb says more people were hit by its October internal-system leak than the 7,159 announced earlier, over a longer period. It has not given a new total and says its exchange service and customer database were not directly breached.
exec: Bithumb says more than the 7,159 people announced earlier were affected by the October leak, which ran 12 to 27 October.
geo_basis: country of the South Korean exchange; city not stated

evidence.quote: 确认个人信息泄露受害者人数已超过此前公布的7159人（客户6444人及员工、合作方员工715人），但暂未公布具体规模。
泄露期间也由此前所称的10月27日约1小时延长至10月12日至27日，外部未授权人员在此期间访问该系统并擅自导出个人信息及文件，泄露项目新增职业、工作单位等信息。
추가로 확인된 구체적인 유출 인원수는 공개하지 않았다.
거래소 서비스나 고객 데이터베이스가 직접 침해된 정황은 없다
사내 모바일 그룹웨어에서 외부로 반출된 자료에 가상자산 거래내역과 지갑주소, 신분증 사본이 포함된 것으로 확인됐다.

validation.note: PANews (relaying Seoul Economic Daily) and EBN Korea both report the victim count exceeds 7,159 and the intrusion ran 12 to 27 October; Bithumb's own notice not read.

review.note: title, date, 7,159/6,444/715, 12-27 Oct period, not-directly-breached statement vs Herald Business and PANews
